services.desc: Stay Safe, Stay Smart-Use Brazilian Jiu Jitsu to Protect Yourself and Create Your Way Out In real-world self defense situations, the goal isn’t to fight-it’s to escape safely. Brazilian Jiu Jitsu (BJJ) is one of the most effective martial arts for exactly that purpose. It teaches you how to defend yourself, regain control, and create space to escape danger-even if your attacker is larger, stronger, or more aggressive. At Daniel Gracie Mainline in Paoli, we teach practical BJJ-based self defense techniques that are grounded in leverage, timing, and strategy-not brute force. Perfect for men and women of all ages, experience levels, and body types, our classes are focused on safety,
